name: ink-pen-sketch
title: Ink pen manga
prompt_block: Single comic panel, black-and-white ink pen manga style with hatching and screentone, matching the reference sheets exactly.
negative_block: No text, letters, words, numbers, speech bubbles, captions or logos anywhere. No colour. No watermark. No extra characters beyond those named.
tested_on: openai-codex gpt-image-2 (bake-off r2, approved by Sahil 23/10/26)
staging_rules: Keep the top 25 percent of the frame as uncluttered background (wall, ceiling or sky) for speech balloons added later.
licence: Prompt text: MIT (this repo). Reference sheets: generated for this project with the owner's image account; fictional characters only.
